lines: Dene waale mujhe maujon ki rawaani de de
couplets.en: O giver, grant me the flowing strength of the waves.

lines: Phir se ek baar mujhe meri jawaani de de
couplets.en: Give me back my youth just once.

lines: Dene waale mujhe maujon ki rawaani de de

lines: Abr ho, jaam ho, saaqi ho mere pehlu mein
couplets.en: Let there be clouds, a cup of wine, and the cupbearer beside me.

lines: Koi to shaam mujhe aisi suhaani de de
couplets.en: Grant me one evening as lovely as this.

lines: Nasha aa jaaye mujhe teri jawaani ki qasam
couplets.en: I swear by your youth that I would feel the wine rise in me.

lines: Tu agar jaam mein bhar ke mujhe paani de de
couplets.en: Even water would do, if you poured it into my cup.

lines: Har jawaan dil mere afsaane ko dohraata rahe
couplets.en: May every young heart keep telling my story.

lines: Hashr tak khatm na ho aisi kahaani de de
couplets.en: Give me a story that will last until the day of reckoning.
